`/accord continue <id>` resumes one ticket, and `/accord` follows this file with that id on that typed form.

Continue applies only when the whole text after it is exactly one
ticket id, the id of a ticket in `accord/tickets/`, an id that
`accord status --json` lists with a `branch`, or a ticket
`accord worktree open <id> --continue` finds; any other text follows `./route.md` with the whole text. Continue on a ticket nobody has claimed
says so, offers `/accord pick-up <id>`, and never claims it.

## Steps

1. Run `accord worktree open <id> --continue` unless it just ran; follow
   `./worktree.md`. The active ticket is its `branch` from
   `accord status --json`, read from git, never from memory.
2. Run `accord anchor`.
3. If `accord/tickets/<id>/debug.md` exists and no `## Resolved` follows its last `## Episode` heading,
   load `accord-debug` and resume there.
4. Otherwise, when it prints `Lane: S`, follow `./lane-s.md` (a title it still needs is made as `./similar.md` says); when it prints `Lane: R`, follow `./lane-r.md`. Else, at any stage
   but `intent`, first run `accord gate ready <id>`; when it fails, show the
   owner what it prints and stop; when it changes the ticket, commit the ticket.
   Then read the file the `## A ticket at a stage` section of `/accord` names for the stage it prints, from the anchor and never from memory. The row is the stage it prints, except that `intent`
   takes the row `approach` at step 5, the owner's yes, when the ticket's
   `## Approach` holds a `- Rejected:` line, at step 3 when it holds only
   the draft of its step 2, otherwise the row `intent`, at step 9 when the anchor's next
   step is the owner's approval, and `done` takes the row `verify` at step 6.
   A lane M stage with no row there runs its own command, `accord-<row>`.
   Resume at the step the anchor names. Never re-run a task
   the ledger records.

## Rules

- Anything touching intent, a veto, an acceptance criterion, or a public
  interface stops the run and asks the owner. Every other decision on a
  ticket is a Ruling in `accord/tickets/<id>/ledger.md` under `## Rulings`.
  Read `./ask.md` before any question to the owner.
- A failure reported in a ticket that has reached verify follows `./failure.md`. `./ids.md` says how a ticket is named, moved to lane S or dropped; a lane proposal follows `./lane.md` and `./scout.md`; a lane S ticket is finished as `./finish.md` says and checked with `./review-security.md`.
